0.question: Can I download any content?
0.answer: No. You should process only your own content or content for which you have authorization, a license, or another valid legal basis.

1.question: Is Baixaboo affiliated with other platforms?
1.answer: No. Baixaboo is independent and is not affiliated with, partnered with, sponsored by, or endorsed by supported platforms.

2.question: Is YouTube the focus of Baixaboo?
2.answer: No. YouTube may be a supported source, but Baixaboo processes different types of links and authorized media files.

3.question: Which formats are available?
3.answer: The available options depend on the original media and the processing service's capabilities.

4.question: Can I download audio only?
4.answer: Yes, when the source provides a compatible audio track.

5.question: Are files stored?
5.answer: No. Content is streamed during the download and is not saved by Baixaboo.

6.question: Can I use the file commercially?
6.answer: Only when the license or authorization from the rights holder permits commercial use.

7.question: Does Baixaboo remove content protection?
7.answer: No. Baixaboo does not bypass DRM, paywalls, access restrictions, or protection mechanisms.

8.question: Will downloads always be available?
8.answer: No. Availability depends on the source, content, permissions, format, and technical or legal limitations.

CopyrightPage.title: Copyright and DMCA
CopyrightPage.intro: Baixaboo respects authors' and rights holders' rights. We do not host or distribute third-party content: we process only links submitted by users, who are responsible for lawful use.

allowed.1: Backups of the user's own materials;
allowed.4: Content used with the rights holder's express permission.

forbidden.1: Distribution, resale, or commercial use without a license;
forbidden.3: Bypassing DRM, paywalls, authentication, or technical restrictions.

CopyrightPage.noticeIntro: Rights holders may request action by sending a notice through the contact channel listed in the footer, including:

noticeItems.0: identification and contact details of the rights holder;
noticeItems.1: a description of the protected work;
noticeItems.2: a precise description of the disputed use;
noticeItems.3: a good-faith statement that the use is unauthorized;
noticeItems.4: a statement that the information provided is accurate.

CopyrightPage.noticeEnd: Valid notices are reviewed as a priority and may result in technical source blocking or suspension of access for repeat infringers.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.intro: This Policy explains which data Baixaboo processes, for what purposes, and for how long, in accordance with applicable Brazilian data-protection law.

items.0: Media links voluntarily submitted by the user for validation and download;
items.1: Technical access data, such as IP address, device type, browser, and language;
items.2: Preferences saved locally on your device, such as the interface theme;
items.3: No media files: Baixaboo does not save copies or create temporary files.

items.0: Validate the link and forward the requested download directly to the browser;
items.1: Maintain security, prevent abuse, and limit automated usage;
items.2: Measure performance and improve the platform experience.

retention.title: 3. Files and retention
retention.text: Baixaboo does not store media files, create queues, or use a database for downloads. Content is streamed from the source to the browser during the request and stops being processed when the connection closes.

sharing.title: 4. Sharing
sharing.text: We do not sell personal data. Data is shared only with infrastructure and measurement providers strictly necessary for operation, limited to the stated purpose, or when required by a competent authority.

rights.title: 5. Your rights

items.0: Confirmation of processing and access to data;
items.1: Correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data;
items.2: Anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary data;
items.3: Withdrawal of consent and objection to specific processing;
items.4: Portability and information about data sharing.

rights.text: Requests can be sent through the contact channel listed in the footer and will be answered within applicable legal deadlines.

security.title: 6. Security
security.text: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect processed data. No system is completely immune to incidents, and we will report relevant events as required by law.

TermsPage.title: Terms of Use
TermsPage.intro: These Terms govern the use of Baixaboo, a technical direct-media-download tool. By using the platform, you fully agree to the conditions below.

service.title: 1. Nature of the service
service.text: Baixaboo is a technical tool that validates media links provided by users and forwards downloads as a stream. The platform does not host, index, catalog, store, or provide third-party content and grants no rights to that content.

responsibility.title: 2. User responsibility
responsibility.text: The user is solely and fully responsible for submitted links and the use of resulting files. By using the platform, the user states that they:

items.0: own the content or have authorization, a license, or another valid legal basis to process it;
items.1: will not use the service to infringe copyright, related rights, or image rights;
items.2: will comply with source-platform terms and applicable law;
items.3: will be responsible for harm caused to third parties through misuse.

items.0: Unauthorized distribution, resale, or commercial use without a license;

items.3: Bypassing DRM, authentication, paywalls, or any technical restrictions;
items.4: Violating the source platform's terms of service;
items.5: Abusive automated use, service overload, or attempts to bypass technical limits.

availability.title: 4. Availability and technical limitations
availability.text: Analysis and download availability depends on the source, content type, permissions, and technical limitations. The service is provided “as is,” without guarantees of continuity, specific quality, or results.

liability.title: 5. Limitation of liability
liability.text: To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Baixaboo is not liable for losses, direct or indirect damages, lost profits, content misuse by users, or violations committed by third parties.

thirdParties.title: 6. No affiliation with third parties
thirdParties.text: Baixaboo is independent and is not affiliated with, partnered with, sponsored by, endorsed by, or approved by any platform, service, brand, or rights holder mentioned on the platform. References to compatible services are informational only.

suspension.title: 7. Suspension of access
suspension.text: We may limit, suspend, or terminate access for users who breach these Terms, without prior notice, especially in cases of abusive or unlawful use.

changes.title: 8. Changes and applicable law
changes.text: These Terms may be updated at any time and take effect when published on this page. Brazilian law applies, including copyright, internet, and data-protection legislation.
